summary: Two text fields with a character counter: a headline already in the warning tone and a promo code that warns earlier.
use: Single-line fields with a length limit where the writer needs to see how much room is left.
spec: Headline has `maxlength={40}`, `counter` and a 37-character value, so the count reads 37/40 in the warning tone
Promo code has `maxlength={12}` and `counter={{ warnAt: 0.75 }}`: the warning tone starts at 9 characters
The count sits beside the description and is the field's accessible description; crossing the threshold is announced once
